changelog:
CSM 1.0.877

Appearance
• CSM's colour settings now actually reach the places you set them for: the CSM settings pages, the CS Manager row inside CloudStream settings, and CSM's own dialogs share one palette.
• Changing the theme preset or a custom colour updates the page you are on immediately instead of after reopening it.
• Turning CSM off restores the colours CSM had changed and stops overriding them.

Home
• Episode Badge now shows the episode total your source reports on supported poster cards.
• The badge refreshes when a card is rebound, keeps CloudStream's own Dub/Sub/rating labels untouched, and removes itself when the card scrolls away or the option is turned off.

Host support
• CSM targets the official CloudStream pre-release app. CloudStream Stable and other hosts are declined before CSM changes any setting, registers a provider or injects UI, and CSM explains why.

Player and downloads
• Offering subtitle burn-in stays off by default and doubly opt-in; CSM checks the host's real Media3 renderer contract first and leaves your download unchanged when the check does not pass.
• Grayscale and invert follow the same Strength slider through one shared colour matrix.

Notes
• Custom palettes apply to CSM's own surfaces. CloudStream's own Compose screens still use CloudStream's own theme system, which offers no supported hook for a plugin palette.
